blocks.text: A randomly selected chronic condition. It uses the category’s existing penalties and treatment.
Location: Any location with this category
Appearance: Mottled rust-like patches grow outward on the actual body over 75 seconds. Transparent artwork stays clear; growth never resets while the episode continues.
Care: Use targeted chronic treatment listed in Care; rest alone does not cure it.
Story connection: No fixed location storyline; ordinary cases may appear wherever the category roll succeeds.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: ordinary condition
